title: Spaceflight Killed 21 People. It Nearly Killed 32 More.

scenes.voiceover: Spaceflight has killed twenty one people. It came within seconds of killing thirty two more. And every single one of them made it home.
These aren't the disasters you know. They're the twelve missions that should have been catastrophes, and the seconds that decided otherwise.
An astronaut who watched flaming chunks of his own ship fly past the window. A commander spinning end over end, seconds from blackout. A man who nearly drowned, in space.
Struck by lightning. Locked out of the airlock. Falling at twenty one times the force of gravity. Every one of them, seconds from death.
Twelve stories, in order, from nineteen sixty two to twenty eighteen. Every astronaut who almost died in space. The full documentary is on the channel. Subscribe to mindwired.
